subject: GCP marketplace incentive renewal & listing fee discussion
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: GCP marketplace incentive renewal & listing fee discussion

Team —

We have the proposed renewal package from GCP for our marketplace listing. Key items to surface:
- Listing fee structure: they propose moving from a flat 6% rebate to a 6% + 1% annual admin fee (effectively reducing our net for small deals).
- Marketing incentive: $180k co-marketing fund (same as current), but now with a quarterly usage milestone attached.
- Listing promotion credits: 3 months of free credits only if we hit $75k ARR from marketplace within the quarter.

I attached a draft spreadsheet that models P&L under their new terms (20260920-gcp-incentive-draft.xlsx).

Asks:
1) Karthik — can you run a quick sensitivity on the $75k gating and whether we can shift to a $50k threshold for Q4?
2) Marcus — finance needs the net revenue delta for forecast adjustments; can you take the attached and drop a conservative/likely/upside column?
3) Soojin — channel/partner ops: what are risks to our partner GTM if we ask them to relax the milestone?

I want to loop GCP marketplace PMs by the 28th so we have time to negotiate before their fiscal promo planning.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: GCP marketplace incentive renewal & listing fee discussion

Marissa — quick pass attached. High level: shifting the gate to $50k materially increases the probability we hit milestone in Q4 (from ~36% to ~67% based on prior quarter cadence). If they agree to a tiered gate (50k for first quarter, 75k thereafter) we preserve incentives and give them comfort.

Notes inline in spreadsheet. Two trade-offs to flag:
- Lower gate -> faster recognition of co-marketing, but increases their risk; we might need stronger reporting cadence.
- If they insist on a 1% admin fee we should push for it to be waived for the first six months after renewal.

-Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@google.com>, GCP Marketplace Team <gcp-marketplace@google.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 16:40:00 -0000
Subject: Fwd: GCP marketplace incentive renewal & listing fee discussion

Elena — looping you in on our internal read on the renewal. We'd like to propose two concrete changes to the draft terms you shared:

1) Reduce the marketplace milestone gating for listing promotion credits from $75k -> $50k for the first renewal quarter, with re-evaluation thereafter.
2) Waive the proposed 1% admin fee for the first six months post-renewal; if waived, we will accept the 6% listing fee structure as presented.

Attached: internal sensitivity showing impact and suggested quarterly cadence.

Can you confirm if these are negotiable? If useful, we can set up a 30-minute call this week to walk through the numbers.

—Marissa

Attachments: 20260920-gcp-incentive-draft.xlsx
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@google.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, GCP Marketplace Team <gcp-marketplace@google.com>
Cc: Jeremy Moss <jmoss@acmecloud.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 10:17:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: GCP marketplace incentive renewal & listing fee discussion

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear ask and the model. Quick reply while I confirm with program leads:

1) We can pilot a reduced gate of $50k for Q4 with the caveat that we will require weekly milestone reporting and a joint post-quarter review. That seems reasonable and helps protect our promotional inventory.
2) The 1% admin fee is part of a broader partner program change; however, we can agree to a 6-month waiver conditioned on a signed renewal addendum and a DocuSign within 10 business days.

We have a draft addendum that reflects those two items. I can share it after we align on the DocuSign flow and the exact language for the reporting cadence. Would you be available Fri 9/1 at 14:00 PT for a quick sync?

Elena

Elena / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and for offering the pilot. Summary & next steps: 

- We accept the pilot: $50k gate for Q4, weekly milestone reporting, joint post-quarter review.
- 1% admin fee waived for six months on the condition of a signed addendum. See attached final negotiation notes (20261004-final-negotiation-notes.pdf).
- Laura, finance will sign the addendum and complete DocuSign by EOD Thu 10/8 so the waiver window begins 10/15.

Elena: please send the finalized addendum link to sign (DocuSign preferred) and a short template for the weekly milestone report so we can stand up the reporting quickly.

Thanks everyone — great example of moving quickly to protect our promotional runway while keeping the program intact.

Best,
Marissa
